title: Wednesday deals: Lego Star Wars advent calendar for £22.99, a Black & Decker heated airer for £99.99 and a Meaco dehumidifier for £125.96
description: The Lego Star Wars advent calendar at its lowest price, a heated airer £60 under Very, a Meaco dehumidifier and two Ninja kitchen deals at Amazon.
intro:
Today is mostly about getting the house ready for winter. Amazon has the Black & Decker 3 Tier Heated Airer at £99.99, about £60 less than Very and Currys charge, and the MeacoDry ABC 10L dehumidifier at £125.96, close to its lowest recorded price. For the kitchen there are two Ninja deals: the Foodi 3-in-1 toaster, grill and panini press in Stone Gold for £119.99, and the Perfect Temperature kettle for £59.99. The Lego Star Wars advent calendar is down to £22.99, the cheapest it has been in three months.

A quick steer: the advent calendar, the airer and the dehumidifier are worth buying now, because you'll want them before December. The Ninja deals and the Philips OneBlade are fair prices rather than record lows, so buy if you need them, or wait for Black Friday. Prices were checked on 28 October.

deals.name: Lego Star Wars Advent Calendar 2026 (75456)
deals.note: Just under the lowest price PriceSpy has recorded in three months (£23), and £7 less than Hamleys and Boots, which both charge £29.99. Star Wars is usually the first Lego calendar to sell out, so buy it now if it's on your list.

deals.name: Black & Decker 3 Tier Heated Clothes Airer, 300W
deals.note: Very and Currys both want £160 for it today. It has been £89.99 before, but this is still a big saving. At 300W it costs about 8p an hour to run at the current price cap, far less than a tumble dryer.

deals.name: MeacoDry ABC 10L Dehumidifier with Laundry Mode, Black
deals.note: About £3 under AO and Boots (£129) and within £7 of the lowest price PriceSpy has recorded (£119). A quiet compressor model with a laundry mode. Good for drying washing indoors and cutting condensation in a flat or small house.

deals.name: Ninja Foodi 3-in-1 Toaster, Grill and Panini Press (ST202UKSTGD), Stone Gold
deals.note: Much cheaper than other sellers of this colour; eBay's listing is £204.99. It toasts, grills and makes toasties in one machine, so it can replace a toaster and a sandwich maker. Only the Stone Gold version is at this price.

deals.name: Ninja Perfect Temperature 1.7L Kettle (KT200UKCP), Black & Copper
deals.note: £10 under Argos (£69.99) and Very (£69) for the black version. You can set the exact water temperature, which is handy for green tea or a cafetière. PriceSpy shows its price falling over the last three months.

deals.name: Philips OneBlade 360 Face + Body (QP2834/23)
deals.note: A new, boxed listing, and the lowest price PriceSpy has recorded for this model (its highest is £36.99). A good stocking filler for anyone who trims rather than shaves. Check the seller's feedback before you buy.

body:
## Worth waiting for?

**Buy now:** the Lego Star Wars advent calendar. Lego calendars sell out before December, and this one is already at its lowest price in three months. The Lego City calendar is £17.99 on Amazon if you'd rather spend less. Our [Lego Black Friday guide](/guides/lego-black-friday-deals-2026/) and [advent calendars guide](/guides/advent-calendars-2026-uk/) have the rest.

**Buy now:** the heated airer and the dehumidifier. Drying kit sells best when the weather turns, so it rarely gets much cheaper in November. This week's spotlight, [how to keep warm for less this winter](/spotlight/keep-warm-for-less-winter-2026/), compares running costs for airers, dehumidifiers, heated throws and heaters.

**Your call:** the two Ninja deals and the OneBlade. They're good prices, but Ninja usually cuts prices widely over Black Friday. Our [Ninja Black Friday guide](/guides/ninja-black-friday-deals-2026/) has the prices worth waiting for.

**New today:** three new guides. [Amazon Black Friday 2026 UK](/guides/amazon-black-friday-2026-uk/), [Very Black Friday 2026](/guides/very-black-friday-2026/) and [Lego advent calendar 2026](/guides/lego-advent-calendar-2026/) cover the dates, what's already cheap and the prices to aim for. For everything else, see [every Black Friday guide](/black-friday/).
